Name: Shaphat, Son of Hori
Summary: Shaphat, Son of Hori was one of the twelve spies Moses sent from the tribe of Simeon to search out the land of Canaan.
KeyStory: Shaphat spent forty days spying out Canaan, then joined the ten who brought back a fearful report that turned Israel back into the wilderness.
RelatedPeople: Hori, Father of Shaphat; Moses; Caleb; Joshua
LifeLesson: Seeing the same land as Caleb, he saw only giants — faith is a choice about what you trust.
